purpose: The share of the range of f and s used on the reference sets of the two versions of work 2 and by the words of the works (point 4 of the decisions of the researcher after round 8 of the pre-review, verdict section 7): under map B (version G0) the whole Japanese lexicon of work 2 mapped by map B, under the author-equal percentiles (version P) the tokens of the 23 works with each author weighing 1, and, to compare the two versions on one set, the same tokens under map B; next to them the 20 words of each trial author and the 40 words together, so that the comparison of section C6 of the outline is made on the same population (minimum to maximum per author next to the quartiles per author). Recommendation 2 of the outline asks for both sets, the reference and the words used.
fixed_before_running: Written on 2026-10-29 and committed before the script was written or run. Seen before: results/calibrate_memolon.json, with the percentiles 0, 1, 25, 50, 75, 99 and 100 (nearest index) of the Japanese lexicon mapped by map B and clipped, from which, f depending on A only and s on V only through an affine rule, the main agent computed before writing these conditions the shares on the whole lexicon under map B: f 73.7% from minimum to maximum and 6.8% between the quartiles (nearest index), s 100% and 11.5%; results/paper_generation_record/generation_record.json, with every value of the 40 words under both versions, from which the shares per author were computed by the main agent (map B f 16.7% and 21.9%, s 45.5% and 28.5%; percentiles f 81.4% and 92.0%, s 93.8% and 86.1%; between the quartiles map B f 3.9% to 5.1%, percentiles f 20.6% to 23.0% and s 51.9% to 56.4%); results/sketch_sp_color/values.json (the percentiles of the 64 keys drawn, the count of reference words and tokens per author). Not seen before: any value of the tokens of the 23 works other than those 64 keys, so the shares on the tokens under both versions and per author. Under the percentiles the reference is spread evenly by its definition (each weighted percentile is the share of the weight below), so its shares near 100% and near 50% are expected from the definition and are a check of the reconstruction, not a finding.

inputs.hashes: values.json is checked against the SHA-256 above (the one of figure 6, of the blind judgement and of the record of generation); the other JSON inputs are checked to be the committed bytes; the lexicon, the map, the tagger and the zips of the 23 works against the SHA-256 of work2.json; calibrate_memolon.json to be the map of work2.json computed on a clean tree; the record of generation to be computed on its conditions on a clean tree with the same values.json and the installed generator

sets.lexicon_B: every entry of the Japanese lexicon of work 2 (japanese_text.load_memolon of the file of work2.json), V and A by map B and clipped (pipeline.calibration_map of calibrate_memolon.json, the map of work 2), each entry once
sets.tokens_P: the reference of results/sketch_sp_color as defined in works/conditions/sketch_sp_color.json (reference.what, select all): the words of the lexicon met in the kept sentences of the 23 works, each word with the weight sum over authors of n / T (n its tokens in the works of the author, T the tokens of the author), so that each author weighs 1; V = 2 p_valence - 1 and A = 2 p_arousal - 1, p the weighted percentile of the raw value of the word among the raw values of the reference (weight below plus half the weight equal, over the total weight), the function weighted_percentile of works/sketch_sp_color.py copied into the script
sets.tokens_B: the same words and weights as tokens_P, V and A by map B and clipped, so that the two versions are compared on one set
sets.per_author: for tokens_P and tokens_B also per author, over the words of the author with the weight n / T
sets.words: the 20 words of each trial author and the 40 words together under G0 and P, as recorded in generation_record.json (words), not computed again

statistics.shape: f, s = atact.mapping.params(V, A); the range of the rule is f in [F0, F0 + F1] = [3, 7] and s in [S0, S0 + S1] = [0.06, 0.30] (p and q at the ends of [0, 1])
statistics.share: 100 (maximum - minimum) / (width of the range of the rule), and 100 (third quartile - first quartile) / (width), per set and quantity
statistics.unweighted: lexicon_B and the words: minimum, maximum and numpy.quantile at 0.25 and 0.75 with method 'linear' (as the record of generation)
statistics.weighted: tokens_P and tokens_B, pooled and per author: minimum and maximum over the words of positive weight, and numpy.quantile at 0.25 and 0.75 with method 'inverted_cdf' and the weights (the smallest value at which the cumulative weight reaches the share)

checks: R1: the constants above hold: 23 works and 6 authors in work2.json, 2003306 entries in the lexicon and in calibrate_memolon.json (japanese_entries), 18301 reference words and the tokens per author equal to those of values.json, 2 trial authors with 20 words each in generation_record.json

R2: the reconstruction of map B on the lexicon: its minimum and maximum of V and A equal the percentiles 0 and 100 of japanese_mapped_clipped_percentiles of calibrate_memolon.json, and its percentiles 25 and 75 by the nearest index (index round(q/100 (n - 1)) of the sorted values, as calibrate_memolon.json) equal those recorded there, exactly

R3: the reconstruction of the reference: the text step of every work gives the sentences and matched tokens of results/work2 (as works/sketch_sp_color.py), and the weighted percentiles of every key of values.json, recomputed from the reference, equal its p_valence_author_equal and p_arousal_author_equal exactly

R4: the words: for G0 the V and A of the 40 words of generation_record.json equal map B of their entries in the lexicon, and for P they equal 2 p - 1 of values.json, exactly; their f and s equal params(V, A)
R5: every V and A of every set lies in [-1, 1] (the lexicon after the clip of map B), so params clips nothing; the clip of map B is counted on the lexicon and recorded (entries changed by it)
R6: the installed atact is the generator named in work2_words.json, and the range of the rule is read from atact.mapping (F0, F1, S0, S1)

outputs.record: reference_range.json: per set (and per author where named) and quantity the minimum, first quartile, third quartile, maximum, the two shares and the number of words (and the total weight for weighted sets); the range of the rule; the checks R1 to R6 with their counts; the SHA-256 of the conditions, the script and every input; the versions and the git state

not_claimed: These are quantities of the generation of the tiles on sets of words, not of how any tile looks. The minimum and maximum are sensitive to extreme values (on the lexicon the maximum of A under map B is set by the clip of a few entries), which is why the quartiles are recorded next to them. The two versions use different reference sets by their definitions (the lexicon for the fit of map B, the 23 works for the percentiles), so their own shares differ in two ways at once; the comparison of the versions on one set is tokens_B against tokens_P. The trial authors were chosen as those of the widest and the narrowest spread, so the shares of their 20 words depend on that choice.
